methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-15 via WebFetch on each official pricing page and WebSearch for blocked/quote pages. Confirmed exact: Hexnode, Miradore, SimpleMDM, Mosyle, Esper, JumpCloud, Microsoft Intune. CORRECTED: (1) ManageEngine MDM Plus cloud is ANNUAL-billed only (no monthly option) — draft's fabricated monthly figures ($64/$119) replaced with monthlyUsd=null and official annual ladders in notes; HIPAA downgraded to null because the SOC2+HIPAA Type 2 audit covers Endpoint Central/ServiceDesk Plus, not MDM Plus specifically. (2) Scalefusion prices are per-device-per-MONTH ($2/$3.50/$5/$6), not per-year as the draft assumed — restored to true monthly figures; official pricing page returns HTTP 403 so figures corroborated via G2/spotsaas/softwaresuggest 2026. Jamf Pro list prices retained as third-party (costbench.com) estimates since Jamf does not publish Pro pricing (jamf.com/pricing is quote-only). No vendors removed — all 11 exist and verify. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
